errors.evidence: The description of the plot's purpose is too generic. It fails to mention the key metric being measured, which is "Informativeness" as indicated by the y-axis label.
The x-axis has no label. "0-CoT" is the label for one of the data series in the legend.
The "0-CoT" series is depicted with circular markers, not triangular ones. The "CoRe" series has triangular markers.
The "CoRe" series (orange line) starts at x=0 with a value slightly above 0.960 (approx. 0.961). The stated value of 0.957 is incorrect and wrongly implies it starts below the "0-CoT" series.
The "CoRe" series ends at x=4 with a value of approximately 0.913. The value 0.910 is the minimum value on the y-axis, and the data point is clearly above this line.
